The acquired information-and-copy scope is defined by this unchanged source function: def disposition_scope(t):
    base=['confidential_information']
    if any_phrase(t,['document','file','material','tangible item','property comprising','embodiment']):
        base=['materials_containing',['confidential_information']]
    if any_phrase(t,['all copies','copies thereof','and all copies','copy thereof','copies, electronic']):
        return ['information_union',base,['copies_of',base]]
    return base

rationale: Extend the common compiler with orthogonal disposition concepts rather than forcing return, destruction, or retention into disclosure predicates. The source update preserves the inherited disclosure reader, extracts operative disposition duties with their actor, trigger, information-and-copy scope, and scoped retention exceptions, and distinguishes request, termination, and completion/cessation triggers. The consumer preserves nda-5/7 behavior and handles nda-16/20 only when an actual disposition or retention root supplies proof. Thus a request-only return duty supports NotMentioned for nda-16, while a source with no disposition norm remains unhandled; an exhaustive return/destruction duty contradicts post-disposition retention unless an express scoped permission applies.

def parse_disposition(raw,ids,out):
    t=raw.casefold()
    if not t:
        return
    actor=['named_recipient','Volunteer'] if 'volunteer' in t else ['receiving_party']
    perm=retention_permission(t,actor)
    if perm is not None:
        add_statement(out,perm,ids)
    no_retain=re.search(r'no[^.;]{0,180}(?:copies|copy|notes|abstracts)[^.;]{0,120}shall be retained',t,re.I) is not None or re.search(r'shall not retain',t,re.I) is not None
    if no_retain:
        add_statement(out,['prohibition',actor,['retain',['copies_of',['confidential_information']]],['after_disposition','return or destruction requirement'],['no_exceptions']],ids)
    has_return=re.search(r'\breturn(?:ed)?\b',t,re.I) is not None
    has_destroy=re.search(r'\bdestroy(?:ed)?\b',t,re.I) is not None and 'not destroyed' not in t
    normative=re.search(r'\b(?:shall|will)\b[^.;]{0,500}\b(?:return(?:ed)?|destroy(?:ed)?)\b',t,re.I) is not None or re.search(r'agrees?[^.;]{0,500}\b(?:return|destroy)\b',t,re.I) is not None
    trigger=disposition_trigger(t)
    if not normative or trigger is None or not (has_return or has_destroy):
        return
    scope=disposition_scope(t)
    action=None
    if has_return:
        action=['return_to',scope,['disclosing_party']]
    if has_destroy:
        d=['destroy',scope]
        action=d if action is None else ['alternative_action',action,d]
    ex=['no_exceptions']
    if perm is not None:
        ex=['exception_set',['permission_exception',perm]]
    add_statement(out,['obligation',actor,action,trigger,ex],ids)
